data.title: Mercer House
data.about:
Ellington Properties unveils Mercer House in Uptown Dubai, a new pinnacle of elegance, featuring a collection of studio, 1, 2, and 3 bedroom residences, along with luxurious four-bedroom penthouses. 

Experience a heightened level of lavish living in a prime location, encompassed by two residential skyscrapers situated atop a health-focused base. This development includes a variety of wellness amenities, alongside retail and hospitality offerings. The location offers breathtaking views of the Jumeirah Island, the Dubai Marina skyline, the iconic Ain Dubai, and the Arabian Gulf.

Mercer House Uptown is set to become a vibrant hub for its inhabitants, infusing Uptown Dubai with fresh vigor. It's a community where everyone feels a sense of belonging, blurring the lines between communal and private experiences. Here, life is enriched with artistic expression, thoughtful design, healthful living, and diverse entertainment options.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy Energised Urban Living
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Varied Residences: Studios, 1-4 bedroom apartments, and penthouses.
  • Wellness Focus: Towers on a wellness-centric podium with extensive facilities.
  • Retail and Hospitality: On-site retail outlets, cafes, and hospitality services.
  • Prime Location: In Uptown Dubai's heart, near Uptown Plaza and Sheikh Zayed Road.
  • City Connectivity: Easy access to Dubai's key landmarks.
  • Luxury Amenities: Fitness zones, pool, gym, and concierge services.
  • Premium Finishes: High-quality materials and elegant interiors.
  • Sophisticated Kitchens: Modern appliances in 3 and 4-bedroom units.
  • Architectural Marvel: Luxurious design and unique aesthetic.
  • Urban Sophistication: Part of the contemporary Uptown Dubai district.
  • Panoramic Views: Overlooking Dubai skyline and Arabian Gulf.
  • Balanced Living: Stylish, comfortable, and functional residences.
  • Community Spirit: Blend of private and shared living experiences.

location_tile.title: Live. Work and Play At Uptown Dubai
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Mercer House is set to energize Uptown Dubai, offering a space where private and shared experiences merge. It enhances living through creativity, design, wellness, and entertainment.

Mercer House at Uptown Dubai symbolizes modern elegance and urban sophistication, with its innovative architecture. This vibrant district blends residential, commercial, and leisure spaces, offering a luxurious lifestyle.

At its heart, Uptown Dubai's skyline, featuring iconic towers, offers a world-class urban experience and stunning views of the Dubai skyline and Arabian Gulf.
